🌟 pgrok | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Exposing local development servers or applications to the internet for testing, collaboration, or public access, with the added benefit of secure HTTPS connections and real-time monitoring.
✨ Key Features: • Expose local ports to the internet • Automatic HTTPS via Caddy • SSH reverse tunnels • Interactive TUI dashboard • HTTP request inspection
📖 Summary: pgrok is a personal alternative to ngrok that exposes local ports to the internet using SSH tunnels and Caddy for automatic HTTPS. It features an interactive TUI dashboard for monitoring and debugging.
